requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: isolated complete iris texture for true Live2D rigging. Reference image is the approved chibi ZJU girl's painting; only her irises are the identity/style reference. Create ONE complete circular iris/pupil/highlight disc centered on a square truly transparent canvas, generously filling about 70 percent of its width. It must match her existing painterly blue-violet iris with indigo upper half, muted pale gold lower half, fine subtle radial/crystalline texture, small round deep navy pupil, a large white highlight near upper right and two smaller subtle highlights. Paint the full 360 degree iris and its dark rim, including the portions normally covered by eyelids. Keep the original gentle watercolor/anime pigment texture and original modest highlight scale; no glossy plastic or photoreal eye, no glow. No sclera, eyelashes, eyelids, eyebrow, skin, hair or face, no school emblem, no text, no shadow or background. The disc must be a complete smoothly edged circle with transparent outside; not a cropped visible eye fragment. We will reuse exact original visible iris pixels over this new hidden-area backing.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: INTERNAL complete skin underpaint layer for Live2D, intentionally a blank bald facial plate, not a redesigned visible face. Edit target is the supplied approved 1254-square transparent chibi illustration. Isolate ONLY her complete peach facial skin and hidden forehead as one single skin head plate at the EXACT original face position, angle, scale and chin contour: original visible face extends roughly x350..870 and y465..909; extend the previously hidden forehead smoothly upward behind the bangs to about y360, and fill a continuous complete head/face shape behind all fringe and eyes. Preserve the original slightly tilted rounded cheeks, small smooth chin, peach gradient, subtle blush and tiny nose highlight EXACTLY. Remove all eyes, eye lines, old iris outlines, brows, mouth, ALL hair and strands, feathers, ribbons, ornaments, neck, body, hands, mouse and keyboard; leave only continuous softly shaded blank facial skin with no holes. No ears need to protrude beyond the original side hair. Maintain full original square canvas alignment; do NOT center, enlarge, rotate, recrop or change the existing face outline. True transparent background outside the isolated skin silhouette, no background, no text, no checkerboard. This hidden skin layer will be under original extracted hair, eyes and mouth, which remain untouched separately.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: complete BACK HAIR ONLY layer for a real Live2D rig. The supplied approved 1254-square chibi girl is the exact style, silhouette, positioning and color reference. Isolate her ink navy and silver-blue long hair as ONE complete rear hair mass at exactly the original canvas position and scale, with the original top crown, long flowing side curls and lower silver-blue tips. Remove the FRONT BANGS and ahoge into separate absent layers; remove all face/skin, eyes, eyebrows, mouth, feathers, blue ribbon ornaments, badges, eagle emblems, neck, clothing, hands, keyboard and mouse. Complete the previously hidden rear hair behind the ENTIRE face, behind the forehead/front bangs, behind both hair accessories and sleeves, as continuous naturally flowing navy hair with the same painterly shading; there must be NO face-shaped hole, accessory holes or hand holes in this rear hair layer. Keep the approved hair outer silhouette and full lower curls rather than adding new volume. The central region behind the removed face is intentionally a solid painted hair mass, which will be covered again by the separate original face layer. One full original-alignment square PNG with genuine transparency outside the hair, no text, no labels, no checkerboard, no new objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: COMPLETE PAWS/HANDS ONLY layer pair for Live2D. The supplied approved square 1254x1254 chibi illustration is the exact source. Isolate ONLY the two peach round little paws in their EXACT existing poses, shape, size, positions, light and painterly skin texture, including the short upper wrist hidden under each cuff. Screen-left paw remains roughly x125..295,y880..980 over the mouse; screen-right paw remains roughly x702..861,y892..991 over the keyboard. Reconstruct a small continuous peach wrist extension above each paw behind its former cuff so the hands are complete independent objects; do not lengthen fingers or make adult hands. Keep every visible knuckle and finger outline and their original tiny shaded creases unchanged. Remove ALL cuff fabric, navy rings, feathers, hair strands, face, torso, devices and emblems. Only two separated small skin hands/wrists on a truly transparent full square canvas in the original registration. No ears, faces, eyes, background, checkerboard or text. Do not recenter, enlarge, reposition or crop the hands.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: COMPLETE SLEEVES/CUFFS ONLY pair for Live2D. Use the supplied approved 1254-square chibi girl as the exact edit target. Isolate ONLY the two original compact navy-blue and white feather-trimmed sleeves/cuffs at EXACTLY their existing positions, scale, pose and perspective: screen-left sleeve spans approximately x80..455,y805..1045, screen-right sleeve x680..982,y868..1000. Preserve their soft painterly navy fabric, fine blue/gold piping and white feather cuff trim; do not redesign them or extend into long arms. Remove ALL peach hands, skin, head, hair, torso, keyboard, mouse and university symbols. Paint complete sleeve fabric and a believable continuous shaded cuff opening behind the removed paws, including the hidden lower sleeve edges behind the mouse/keyboard. The cuff inner opening has dark cloth/lining and a soft natural seam, with NO hand-shaped transparent hole and NO skin remnants. Each sleeve must be a self-contained complete cloth object with generous concealed attachment overlap at the upper root for head/body movement. Keep the original full square canvas registration, true alpha outside ONLY the two sleeves, no captions, labels, checkerboard, background or new objects.
